verdict.rationale: Neon's in-product SQL Editor has AI features that help write, optimize, and name SQL queries. However, the AI sees only the schema, not your actual data ('no actual data is shared'), so it suggests queries rather than giving data-derived insights. Other AI routes either run outside the product (MCP-connected agents running SQL or inspect_database, Copilot agents for query optimization) or answer only from Neon's docs (`neon ask`). Missing for 10: AI insights generated from the actual data inside the console, proactive suggestions or anomaly detection, any hands-on or independent corroboration of the SQL Editor AI.
